arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = table

SELECT 'bookings' AS kind, json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'confirmed_at',b.confirmed_at,'hold',h.booking_id) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'charges',json_object('id',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges
UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('id',event_id,'request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights
UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds
UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache

SELECT 'pending' kind,json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'reference',b.client_reference,'cancel_step',e.step,'charge',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'created',c.created_step) data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'confirmation_missing_hold_charge_checkin_or_event' AS check_name,count(*) AS violations FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id AND k.flight_id=b.flight_id AND k.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered'))
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_still_holding_or_checked_in',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id))
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_without_cancel_event',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id AND e.kind='cancel')
UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_refund',count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND c.state='captured' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.charge_id=c.charge_id AND r.booking_id=b.booking_id AND r.amount_cents=c.amount_cents)
UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sales',count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold',count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity
UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_bookings',count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_outbox',count(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'
